Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728

Class McpCacheConfig

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728.McpCacheConfig
public class McpCacheConfig extends Object
Binding-owned, immutable-after-construction cache configuration for a v2 McpRevision.

Applications populate one McpCacheConfig and pass it to McpRevision(org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728.ServerCapabilities, McpCacheConfig). Every setter validates its McpCacheHint argument eagerly (including entries assigned via setResourceReadOverrides(Map)), so an invalid TTL fails at configuration time rather than at dispatch time.

This type holds no resolution logic; precedence between getDefaultHint(), the per-method hints, and getResourceReadOverrides() is owned by McpRevision.
